user.title: Set up Kimai Homeoffice
user.description: Enter the Kimai URL and your API token.

project.title: Select project
project.description: Choose the Kimai project used for home office time tracking.

activity.title: Select activity
activity.description: Choose the activity used when clocking in.

error.cannot_connect: Kimai is not reachable. Check URL and network.
error.auth: The API token is invalid or lacks permission.
error.unknown: Unknown error. See Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Kimai URL is already configured.

init.title: Configure options
init.description: Configure automatic start and stop settings.

data_description.auto_start: Automatically starts a Kimai time entry when the work computer sensor turns on.
data_description.worker_sensor: Select the sensor or binary sensor that represents your work computer or home office status.
data_description.start_after: Earliest time for automatic start in HH:MM format.
data_description.start_before: Latest time for automatic start in HH:MM format.
data_description.offline_stop: Automatically stops the running Kimai time entry when the work computer sensor goes offline.
data_description.offline_minutes: Number of minutes to wait before clocking out after the sensor goes offline.
data_description.safety_stop: Stops the running Kimai time entry at a fixed time each day.
data_description.safety_stop_time: Time for the safety stop in HH:MM format.
data_description.notify: Sends a notification after automatic clock-out.
data_description.notify_service: Home Assistant notify service, for example notify.mobile_app_alex_iphone.

error.invalid_time: Invalid time format. Please use HH:MM.
error.invalid_time_range: Start and end time must not be equal.
